fields.causal_definition: Formation rule observable by formation; categorical, not the eventual floor.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.
fields.name: formation_source

fields.causal_definition: Bell-source token only if its publication epoch is verified <= receipt.
fields.leakage_exclusions: Trade-density inference and undated historical machine receipts are retrospective; excluded from features.
fields.name: bell_source

fields.causal_definition: First in-span observed finite positive non-crossed BBO, on the filed bell clock; not a liquidity threshold.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.
fields.name: book_wake_mtb

fields.causal_definition: Elapsed receipt minutes since that first observed BBO; absent before wake.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.
fields.name: book_awake_minutes

fields.causal_definition: Median of completed inter-print gaps since formation, observed by this receipt.
fields.leakage_exclusions: Full-span library cadence_s is NEVER a predictor; fewer than two observed prints => missing.
fields.name: prefix_cadence_seconds

fields.causal_definition: Diagnostic rank interval using filed quantiles, learned only from earlier resolved games; no second vote for cadence.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.
fields.name: cadence_class

fields.causal_definition: Current ask minus bid, cents; crossed books missing.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.
fields.name: spread_cents

fields.causal_definition: Filed Foundation label applied to current spread; diagnostic only, not a duplicated spread vote.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.
fields.name: spread_band

fields.causal_definition: Current completed-minute bid close minus previous completed-minute bid close; quote movement, NOT observed consumption.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.
fields.name: bid_consumption_velocity

fields.causal_definition: Current completed-minute ask close minus previous completed-minute ask close; quote movement, NOT observed consumption.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.
fields.name: ask_consumption_velocity

fields.causal_definition: YES-aggressor contracts minus NO-aggressor contracts in latest completed minute; missing if any positive-size print is unattributed.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.
fields.name: taker_flow

fields.causal_definition: Sum of sizes with taker_side=yes in latest completed minute; not an event count.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.
fields.name: taker_yes_contracts

fields.causal_definition: Sum of sizes with taker_side=no in latest completed minute; not an event count.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.
fields.name: taker_no_contracts

fields.causal_definition: Distinct traded prices in latest completed minute; not consumed resting levels.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.
fields.name: distinct_levels_traded

fields.causal_definition: Stored bid_depth_5 / (bid_depth_5 + ask_depth_5); latest observed snapshot, zero denominator missing.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.
fields.name: depth_ratio

fields.causal_definition: Latest observed sum of five bid sizes, contracts.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.
fields.name: bid_depth_5

fields.causal_definition: Latest observed sum of five ask sizes, contracts.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.
fields.name: ask_depth_5

fields.causal_definition: Signed taker flow times that completed minute's bid-close change; learned interaction, not a trading rule.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.
fields.name: pressure_x_bid_response

fields.causal_definition: NO-aggressor contracts times bid-depth change between the same consecutive completed-minute closes; no replenishment claim from quote prices alone.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.
fields.name: sell_pressure_x_replenishment

fields.causal_definition: Population standard deviation of within-minute inter-trade gaps, at minute close; undefined with fewer than three trades.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.
fields.name: trade_clustering

fields.causal_definition: Number of completed in-span minutes with positive volume, causal count underlying the filed intensity class.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.

fields.causal_definition: Share of completed in-span minute buckets with positive volume; full-lifetime intensity excluded.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.

fields.causal_definition: Latest observed OI available by receipt, never backfilled from later observations.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.

fields.causal_definition: Change between consecutive observed completed-minute OI values; unavailable if either value missing.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.
fields.name: open_interest_delta

fields.causal_definition: Other leg's causally carried bid.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.

fields.causal_definition: Other leg's causally carried ask.
fields.leakage_exclusions: No observation after the receipt; missing is not zero.

fields.causal_definition: Sum of both bids, cents.

fields.causal_definition: Availability only in v1; UNKNOWN without verified sequence coverage, not inferred from date or bucket presence.

fields.causal_definition: An exact-key in-span snapshot has been observed by receipt; undated rows and unjoinable backup excluded.

fields.name: odds_available

print_counts_provenance.calibration_scope: All oriented library legs in category, no named games. Retrospective data-set scale, not per-query walk-forward calibration.

checks.grid_identity: Every library leg, in library order; own floor(native ts) seconds with accepted in-span prints; independent of library change points

print_counts_provenance.gate_join: Latest sidecar second <= gate epoch; zero before the first print second. Independent accepted-print-second count grid; library price/change-point grid unchanged. Second bucket labels are floor(native ts), not subsecond arrival times.
print_counts_provenance.source: true_print_count_in_span from tick-library rows; exact gate-prefix counts from cutter-bound sidecar

restrictions: Source provenance counts are not per-receipt feature availability.
No Foundation full-lifetime intensity or full-leg cadence enters the feature vector.
Native library spans and FIRST eligibility remain unchanged.
Bell clock is the filed replay ruler; inferred bell-source metadata is not causal evidence.
